{{< include ../_includes/lang-switcher/modules.en.qmd >}}

Imagine this site as a short trip with **five** stops. Each stop has **four sections**, twenty sittings in all.

You begin in a garden and a kitchen, with plants, processing, brewing, and the compounds in a mug. From there you travel inward, into the body and brain. Then you climb out into history and living tea cultures. You pause on warmth, ritual, and expectation, where context is part of the dose. You end in a lab, where people play careful games about risk and trust. Each section answers a question the previous one left hanging.

Nothing here requires a science degree. Each section opens with a hook and walks you through the facts in story order. Sources are cited with **clickable footnotes**. Denser detail is tucked into **collapsed foldouts**. Previous and next doors stay open.

## The itinerary (five hubs)

| Stop | The question that pulls you forward | Open |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. The Chemical Core | Why do two cups from the same plant taste—and feel—so different? | [Chapter 1 hub](module-01/index.qmd) |
| 2. Body, Brain & Mood | Why does tea so often feel awake *and* calmer than coffee? | [Chapter 2 hub](module-02/index.qmd) |
| 3. History & Culture | Who controlled the leaf—and how do regions stage the cup? | [Chapter 3 hub](module-03/index.qmd) |
| 4. Context & Ritual Psychology | Is context part of the dose—warmth, ritual, expectation? | [Chapter 4 hub](module-04/index.qmd) |
| 5. Decisions & Choices | Does the cup change how we choose—and how do researchers even measure that? | [Chapter 5 hub](module-05/index.qmd) |

## If you only have ten minutes

**"What do aisle labels mean?"**  
If that is the question, start with [Tea basics](../tea-basics.qmd), then open the [Chapter 1 hub](module-01/index.qmd).

**"What's in my cup?"**  
If that is the question, start with the [Cup reference](../cup-reference.qmd), then read [Chapter 1 · Section 3 · Brewing](module-01/03-brewing.qmd) and [Chapter 1 · Section 4 · Compounds](module-01/04-compounds.qmd).

**"Why awake but not jittery?"**  
For that feeling, go to the [Chapter 2 hub](module-02/index.qmd), then the [Linkages](../linkages.qmd#why-waiting-after-the-first-sip-matters) bridge on [L-theanine](../glossary.qmd#l-theanine) timing and calm brain waves.

**"Is tea only chemistry?"**  
No. The [Chapter 3 hub](module-03/index.qmd) is the zoom-out: trade, monasteries, plantations, and regional scripts. The [Chapter 4 hub](module-04/index.qmd) adds warmth, ritual, and expectation.

**"Do drinks change choices?"**  
Open the [Chapter 5 hub](module-05/index.qmd), with the caveat that lab doses are not your everyday mug.

When you are ready to begin at the beginning, open [Chapter 1](module-01/index.qmd). The water is already hot.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Click for more detail: footnotes and foldouts"}
- **Footnotes:** the superscript numbers jump to the full citation, and the caret jumps back. Hover often pops the note.
- **Foldouts:** boxes titled "More detail…" or "Click for more detail" stay closed until you open them, so the main story stays readable while the expansion stays one click away.
:::
